notes.title: Discover Stratside, a Lemmings-opposite game from outer space!
notes.content:
Stratside is a Puzzle Defense game where you save planets from a gravity-changing enemy! It's like opposite of Lemmings: here you don't help happy characters reach a goal, but prevent a powerful enemy from fulfilling his planet destruction plan! 

In Stratside's demo you can play the first 12 levels of the game, so come and get started! Thanks to Steam Cloud, your progress can be preserved once you move to the final game! 

The demo is now available! Get the full game if you like it!

notes.title: Releasing on June 15th!
notes.content:
Hi players,

Stratside is coming to Steam on June 15th, 2020! 

As a warm up, you can play the demo, wishlist the game and share the game page with your friends! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/604990/Stratside/

Thank you!

Albert

notes.title: Demo & Chat in Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
Hi players!

I am Albert Espín, the developer of Stratside. The game is coming to the Steam Game Festival, so you can play a demo! The progress that you make in the 12 levels included in the demo will be preserved for the full game!

On June 16th, there will be a Chat Session in the Group Chat of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/604990/]Stratside's Steam Community Page[/url]. It will be a great opportunity to ask your questions about the game, and I will do my best to answer them!

It would be also great if you can answer a survey with your demo impressions: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc81kFoi7rFDQ8rpQmmweMAYxP7ZtpYGWT85MzZpUquzIkkvA/viewform?usp=sf_link


Set a reminder for this Chat Session!

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer!
notes.content:

notes.title: On the way to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

My name is Albert Espín and I am the developer of Stratside.

The game is still under development but it has reached a phase in which its audiovisual features are not too far from those expected in the final product. Therefore, I think it is a great time to publicly show the game.

Since development has not finished (it is expected to last for some months), it would be very interesting to hear your first feedback and impressions from the game, and you can also ask any questions you have. It would help to improve the game, and I would be very thankful! You can add comments here or in Stratside's Steam discussions.

I will add more announcements throughout the remaining development process, so let's keep in touch! 

Thank you!


Albert
